_source: Reference implementation of the payback calculator, confirmed final by the product team

head.text: Pays back in month 14, in year 2.

payback.renewLine: At renewal you would pay about €1.5M a year for vRA and vRO.
payback.anchor: Avoiding €1.5M a year, from the renewal in 12 months.
payback.sub: Over 3 years, you save €2.8M by migrating to Kestra, after €210K in migration costs (before Kestra licensing).
payback.solve:
You'd still save at any Kestra price up to €930K a year.
For reference, a Fortune 500 manufacturer that replaced vRA reports licensing costs 90% below Aria Automation.
